items.title: Ri3D at LSSU 2027 Build Thread
items.summary: Hey Chief Delphi! We’re LSSU Robot in 3 Days , a new Ri3D team at Lake Superior State University up in Sault Ste. Marie, Michigan. BIOCORE will be our first season. Who we are We’re Lakers in LSSU’s engineering and technology programs plus a few local FRC mentors, we had our first meeting today, elected our officers and a Build Captain, and we’ll be meeting every Sunday until kickoff. Why the Soo …
